story.originalTitle: Mercedes explains "out of phase" developments compared with other F1 teams
story.summaryEn: Mercedes technical director James Allison said the team's decision to freeze its 2026 car design later put it "out of phase" with rivals, causing a leapfrog effect as in-season updates produce large performance gains. The W17 has been the class of the field, starting with a 1-2 in Australia and claiming eight wins so far.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯解释与其他F1车队“不同步”的研发策略
尽管赛季开局占得先机，但将W17设计推向极限的决定，使梅赛德斯在F1 2026年的研发竞争中“不同步”。
梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森表示，车队决定较晚继续研发其2026年F1赛车，这使其与其他车队“不同步”，导致赛季中期升级带来巨大性能提升，产生跳跃效应。
W17迄今为止是场上最优秀的赛车，赛季初在澳大利亚获得1-2名，并在F1新时代的前11场比赛中取得八场胜利。尽管该车队是明确的冠军热门，但这并未阻止法拉利和迈凯伦在2026赛季凭借实力击败它获胜。
艾利森在车队的Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show播客中表示，车队在风洞中每周找到的圈速提升约为上赛季的“六到七倍”。这展示了在新规则下寻找提升与在更成熟、生命周期末端的规则下寻找提升之间的差异。
他还透露，车队选择较晚推进W17赛车的设计。当车队设计赛车时，通常会选择一个“设计冻结”点，届时赛车将按原样制造，进一步的研发将打包为赛季后期的升级。
梅赛德斯选择将冻结点推迟，压缩了制造时间，但允许其有效地将早期升级纳入首发赛车。艾利森表示，如果出现问题，这“毫无余量”，但这让车队得以利用持续的研发曲线。
“在空气动力学方面，风洞中每一周过去所带来的增益率，我们找到的圈速提升——那就是增益率——大约是去年的六到七倍，”艾利森说。
“大约每两个月0.5秒，差不多是这样，所以这真的非常陡峭。我们竭尽全力在年初推出一辆强大的赛车。
“谢天谢地，这是一次相当不错的努力。但我们研发策略的一件事是，我们在空气动力学方面和车身方面内部决定，要比以往任何时候都晚几周才定稿。而且我们要制定一个毫无余量的计划。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
“由于那个计划，我们尽可能多地将那非常非常陡峭的研发斜率，在首场比赛的首辆赛车中体现出来，我认为这是人力所能及的极限。我们为此倾尽所有。其他车队或许没有以如此晚刹车、如此接近极限的方式到来。因此，他们更早地升级了赛车。”
艾利森表示，尽管这在年初为梅赛德斯带来了优势，但也让车队没有后续储备。这使其在推出升级方面比对手落后“一两场比赛”，因为它必须储备进一步的改进。
他解释说，当其他车队带来升级时，0.5秒的优势可能被完全抹平，这让梅赛德斯在等待自身研发以恢复优势期间可能处于脆弱状态。
这解释了车队之间性能的起伏；法拉利在巴塞罗那凭借可观的升级包找到了速度，而迈凯伦在匈牙利的新底板为其铺平了通往赛季首胜的道路。
“他们更早地修好了赛车，然后他们研发的第一批升级在赛季中更早到来。所以我们到来时，你知道，性能充沛，但全部用尽了，”艾利森继续说道。
“我们一直在加油以提供更多，我们有点不同步。由于提前到来，我们的研发计划现在比其他人的升级节奏慢一两场比赛。
“从我们看到的圈速来看，似乎每个人都处于与我们相同的斜率上。每个人都在以大约每两个月0.5秒的速度研发。因此，在研发周期中不同步半步，意味着你可以拥有像我们年初那样的0.5秒优势。
“一个研发周期就会将其抹平。这感觉相当可怕。但你也知道，油箱里还有存货。只是我们何时带来我们的部件的问题。
“我们的策略就是努力保持领先，并确保我们交付的下一批性能将恢复原状，恢复我们在赛季初投入的优势。
“我们只需挺过这些可怕的时刻，即其他人带来他们所有花哨的新部件的时候。”
detailEn: Mercedes explains "out of phase" developments compared with other F1 teams
Despite starting the season on the front foot, a decision to push the W17's design to the limit left Mercedes "out of phase" in F1's 2026 development battle

Mercedes technical director James Allison says the team's decision to keep developing its 2026 Formula 1 car late has put it "out of phase" with the other teams around it, causing a leapfrog effect as in-season updates produce large performance gains.

The W17 has been the class of the field so far, starting out the year with a 1-2 finish in Australia and going on to claim eight wins in the opening 11 races of F1's new era. Although the team is the firm championship favourite, this has not stopped the likes of Ferrari and McLaren beating it to victories on merit over the course of 2026.

Allison, speaking on the team's Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show podcast, stated that the team was finding "about six to seven times" more lap time per week in the wind tunnel compared to last season. This demonstrates the difference between finding gains under a new ruleset compared to a more mature, end-of-life set of regulations.

He also revealed that the team had elected to push the design of its W17 car late. When teams design their cars, they usually elect a "design freeze" point, where the car will be manufactured as-is and further developments will be packaged up as updates for later in the season.

Mercedes chose to move that freeze point back, compressing the manufacturing time but allowing it to effectively include early-season updates into the launch car. Allison says that this had "less than no contingency" if issues arose, but it allowed the team to take advantage of the continued development curve.
"Aerodynamically, the gain rate for each passing week in the wind tunnel, the amount of lap time we find – that's the gain rate – is about six to seven times what it was last year," Allison said.

"It's about half a second every two months, something like that, so that's really, really steep. And we did everything in our power to launch a car at the start of the year that was going to be strong.

"Thank goodness it was a fair effort. But one of the things about our development strategy was we took a decision internally on the aerodynamic side and on the bodywork side of the car that we were going to leave it later than we've ever left a car before, by several weeks. And that we were going to do a plan that had less than no contingency in it.
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, George Russell, Mercedes

"As a result of that plan, we got as much, that very, very steep development slope, we got as much of that steep development slope in the first car at the first race as I think was humanly possible to get in there. And we emptied everything out to do that. Other teams maybe didn't arrive with quite the sort of quite such a late braking, as close to the wire result. As a consequence, they updated their car sooner."

Allison says that, although this offered Mercedes an advantage at the start of the year, it left the team with nothing in the pipeline. This has put it "a race or two" behind its rivals in terms of producing updates, as it had to stock up on its further refinements.

He explained that a half-second advantage could be completely wiped out by the time other teams bring their updates, and this has left Mercedes potentially vulnerable while it awaits its own developments in the hope of restoring that advantage.

This explains the ebb-and-flow in performance between the teams; Ferrari found pace in Barcelona with a considerable update package, while McLaren's new floor in Hungary greased its own path to a first race win of the season.

"They fixed their car earlier in time, they then were developing the first upgrade to arrive sooner in the season. So we arrived, you know, bristling with performance, but with all of it spent," Allison continued.

"We've been filling up our tanks to give more, and we're a bit out of phase. And our development program, as a result of arriving early, is now running a race or two after the update rates of the others.

"It appears, looking at the lap times we're seeing, that everyone's on this same slope we're on. Everyone is developing around about half a second every two months. And so with that, being out of phase half a step with the development cycle means that you can have half a second like we did at the start of the year.
"One development cycle will bring that to nothing. And that feels quite scary. But also, you know that there's a load in the tank. It's just a question of when we're going to bring our bits.

"Our strategy is just to try to keep our nose ahead and to make sure that the next lump of performance that we deliver will restore the status quo ante, restore the goodness we put in at the beginning of the season.
"We just have to ride out these scary events where other people bring all their fancy new bits."

梅赛德斯将设计冻结点推迟数周，压缩制造时间，将早期升级直接纳入首发赛车，但计划“毫无余量”。
由于提前耗尽升级，梅赛德斯升级节奏比对手慢“一两场比赛”，法拉利在巴塞罗那、迈凯伦在匈牙利凭借升级获胜。

Having spent its updates early, Mercedes is "a race or two" behind rivals in the development cycle, with Ferrari finding pace in Barcelona and McLaren winning in Hungary thanks to updates.

relatedItems.titleZh: 赫塔或于2027年取代博塔斯加盟凯迪拉克
relatedItems.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克2027年F1车手阵容尚未确定，储备车手科尔顿·赫塔是可能取代瓦尔特利·博塔斯的人选之一。车队领队马尔钦·布德科夫斯基在奥斯汀表示，车手合同不会在新闻发布会上讨论。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Herta could replace Bottas at Cadillac in F1 2027
relatedItems.summaryEn: Cadillac's 2027 Formula 1 driver line-up is not yet finalised, with reserve driver Colton Herta among those in contention to replace Valtteri Bottas. Team boss Marcin Budkowski said in Austin that driver contracts are not something discussed in the press.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克2027年F1车手阵容尚未确定，储备车手科尔顿·赫塔是可能取代瓦尔特利·博塔斯的人选之一。
博塔斯和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯都以长期合同加入F1 2026年新军凯迪拉克，但The Race了解到，车队尚未就明年由谁驾驶做出最终决定。
在周五的奥斯汀新闻发布会上，被问及佩雷斯和博塔斯是否会留队至2027年时，凯迪拉克车队领队马尔钦·布德科夫斯基没有排除这种可能。
“这是我最不可能评论车手合同的地方，总的来说，我认为这不是在新闻发布会上做的事，”布德科夫斯基说。
“这件事会在时机成熟时由车队通过官方发布来完成。”
凯迪拉克必须在两种选择之间做出决定：是保持连续性，继续沿用两位熟悉冠军车队运作的资深车手，还是认为现在正是做出改变、为未来争取更大潜在收益的合适时机。
没有任何迹象表明佩雷兹有失去席位的风险，因为今年他一直是凯迪拉克表现更强的车手，并在幕后大力推动车队改进。
今年排位赛中，博塔斯和佩雷兹实力相当接近，佩雷兹以13比9领先博塔斯，但在正赛中佩雷兹拥有明显优势。在两人同时于赛道上的比赛圈数中，博塔斯仅有18%的时间领先于佩雷兹。
博塔斯也经历了一些特别艰难的大奖赛，包括上一场在新加坡的比赛，他在那里的圈速比佩雷兹慢了约1.5秒，且没有明确的解释。
这意味着他在2027年的席位存疑，26岁的赫塔是可能取代他的人选之一。
为什么“令人失望”的F2赛季没有损害赫塔的机会
赫塔今年从印地赛车转投二级方程式，明确目标就是进入F1——2023年他曾非常接近红牛青训车队的位置。
赫塔自称他在F2的赛季表现“令人失望”，在22名全职车手中排名第19位，而赛季还剩卡塔尔和阿布扎比两站。
“对我来说，也许问题比答案多，也许进入这个赛季时问题更多，所以我对这方面的一切都相当失望，”赫塔在奥斯汀说。
“我只是对今年的进展感到失望；一点都不好。”
赫塔明年不太可能留在F2再跑一个赛季，但他已经明确表示，他仍然希望明年能有某种形式的比赛计划，而F1仍然是最终目标。
凯迪拉克并未因赫塔在F2令人失望的表现而退缩，因为它知道完成这一转变会很困难，并且对赫塔在其F1赛车中所做的工作印象深刻。
然而，这确实意味着赫塔的锦标赛最终排名几乎肯定无法为他赢得任何来自F2的超级驾照积分，但凯迪拉克正在确保他将达到40分的门槛。
周五在奥斯汀，赫塔参加了今年第四次第一节自由练习，但其中只有三次有资格获得超级驾照奖励积分，因为蒙扎的一次技术问题意味着他没有完成获得超级驾照积分所需的100公里运行里程。
这一点，加上他在印地赛车中的成绩——包括2024年获得亚军、仅次于冠军亚历克斯·帕劳的30分——意味着他现在距离门槛只差一分。
The Race 了解到，赫塔将在年底前再参加一次第一节练习赛，以确保他达到 40 分，从而成为 2027 年的一个选项。
赫塔还在赛道之外完成了私人的 F1 测试，作为 阿尔派 车队旧车测试（TPC）项目的一部分在波尔蒂芒驾驶，他驾驶的是地面效应时代的赛车。
凯迪拉克没有自己的旧车测试（TPC）项目，因此，就像 2025 年底让佩雷兹驾驶旧法拉利一样，它已与一支竞争对手车队达成协议，以确保赫塔获得更多里程。
自从最初以安德雷蒂的名义争取 F1 参赛资格以来，凯迪拉克一直表示，如果有美国车手能凭实力赢得席位，它希望拥有这样一位车手，而赫塔是最合乎逻辑的候选人。
其他竞争者？
赫塔并非博塔斯席位的唯一竞争者，因为多位车手一直在联系凯迪拉克——这是唯一“开放”的席位，而小红牛只在红牛签约车手之间做选择。
埃斯特班·奥康在输给法拉利青训车手拉斐尔·卡马拉后，正寻求明年留在F1发车区的方法，但The Race了解到他不会以正赛车手或储备车手的身份加入凯迪拉克。
相反，他很可能在另一支车队担任储备车手，例如阿斯顿·马丁。
红牛储备车手角田裕毅在今年早些时候意外代表小红牛出战三场比赛后，正寻求永久重返发车格。
角田裕毅的经纪人已就2027年的机会与凯迪拉克接触，他是候选人之一。
凯迪拉克并不急于做出最终决定，因为其他候选人目前都没有其他车队正式车手席位的机会。
如果凯迪拉克选择在2027年替换博塔斯，鉴于博塔斯与车队有长期合同，双方需要达成某种安排。
detailEn: Cadillac's 2027 Formula 1 driver line-up isn't yet finalised, with reserve driver Colton Herta among those in contention to replace Valtteri Bottas.
Both Bottas and Sergio Perez joined F1's 2026 new team Cadillac on long-term deals, but The Race understands the team hasn't made a final decision on who will drive for it next year.
In the Austin press conference on Friday, Cadillac team boss Marcin Budkowski left the door open when asked if Perez and Bottas will stay on for 2027.
"This is the last place I would comment on driver contracts, and in general, I think it's not something that is done in the press," Budkowski said.
"It's something which will be done by official releases from the team when the time is right."

Cadillac has to decide between sticking with the continuity of its two experienced drivers with knowledge of championship-winning teams or whether it's the right time to make a change with potentially bigger upsides for the future.
There's nothing to suggest Perez is at risk of losing his seat, as he's been the stronger Cadillac driver this year and has pushed the team hard behind-the-scenes to improve.

Bottas and Perez have been fairly evenly matched in qualifying this year, with Perez leading Bottas 13-9, but it's in the races where Perez has had a clear margin. Bottas has only spent 18% of the racing laps they've both been on track ahead of Perez.
Bottas has also had some particularly tough grands prix, including the last race in Singapore, where he was lapping around 1.5 seconds slower than Perez without a clear explanation.
That means his seat is in doubt for 2027, with 26-year-old Herta among those who could replace him.
Why "disappointing" F2 season hasn't hurt Herta's chances
Herta swapped IndyCar for Formula 2 this year with the specific aim of reaching F1 - something he came very close to with Red Bull's junior team in 2023.
Herta has had a self-described "disappointing" F2 campaign as he's 19th out of 22 full-time drivers with two rounds in Qatar and Abu Dhabi remaining.
"Maybe a few more questions than answers for me, maybe more questions than going into it, so I'm fairly disappointed with everything on that side of things," Herta said at Austin.
"I'm just disappointed with how the year's gone; it's not been good at all."
It's unlikely Herta will stay in F2 for a second season next year, but he's made it clear he'd still like a racing programme of some kind next year, with F1 still the ultimate goal.
Cadillac isn't put off by Herta's disappointing F2 performances as it knew making the switch would be difficult, and it's been impressed by the work Herta has done in its F1 car.
It does mean, however, that Herta's championship finish is all but certain not to earn him any superlicence points from F2, but Cadillac is ensuring he'll reach the 40-point threshold.

Herta took part in his fourth FP1 of the year at Austin on Friday, but only three of those are eligible for the superlicence bonus point, as a technical issue at Monza meant he didn't clear the 100km of running necessary to gain the superlicence point.
That, added together with his IndyCar results - including 30 points for finishing runner-up to champion Alex Palou in 2024 - means he's now one point away from the threshold.
The Race understands Herta will do another FP1 before the end of the year to make sure he gets to 40 points so he can be an option for 2027.

Herta has also completed private F1 testing away from the circuit, having run in an Alpine as part of that team's Testing of Previous Cars programme at Portimao, where he ran in a ground effect-era car.
Cadillac doesn't have a TPC programme of its own, so, just as when it ran Perez in an old Ferrari in late 2025, it's struck a deal with a rival team to ensure Herta gets more mileage.
Since first gunning for an F1 entry under the Andretti banner, Cadillac has long stated its ambition to have an American driver if one can earn a seat on merit with Herta the most logical candidate.
Other contenders?
Herta isn't the only contender for Bottas's seat, as multiple drivers have been contacting Cadillac - it's the only ‘open' seat, with Racing Bulls only picking between Red Bull-contracted drivers.

Esteban Ocon is looking for a way to stay on the F1 grid next year after losing his seat to Ferrari junior Rafael Camara, but The Race understands he won't be joining Cadillac in a race or reserve driver role.
Instead, he's likely to take a reserve driver role at a different team such as Aston Martin.
Red Bull reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda is looking for a permanent return to the grid after his unexpected three-race return with Racing Bulls earlier this year.
Tsunoda's representatives have been contacting Cadillac over a 2027 opportunity and he is among the contenders.
Cadillac isn't in a rush to make a final decision, as none of the candidates have race seat options elsewhere.
Should it elect to replace Bottas for 2027, it would need to come to some kind of arrangement given he has a long-term deal with the team.
keyPointsZh: 博塔斯和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯都以长期合同加入凯迪拉克，但车队尚未就明年由谁驾驶做出最终决定。
布德科夫斯基表示，车手合同事宜将在合适时机由车队官方发布。
佩雷斯今年是凯迪拉克表现更强的车手，排位赛以13比9领先博塔斯，正赛优势更为明显。
keyPointsEn: Both Bottas and Sergio Perez joined Cadillac on long-term deals, but the team has not made a final decision on who will drive for it next year.
Budkowski said driver contract matters will be handled through official team releases when the time is right.
Perez has been the stronger Cadillac driver this year, leading Bottas 13-9 in qualifying with a clearer margin in races.

detailZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多在美国大奖赛前夕的现场表演令F1粉丝感到惊喜
前F1车手丹尼尔·里卡多与音乐家罗布·贝尔德一起吹奏口琴，令粉丝感到惊喜
丹尼尔·里卡多，Drive to Survive第七季
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
前一级方程式车手丹尼尔·里卡多在美国德克萨斯州奥斯汀的舞台上出现了一个惊喜。
这位澳大利亚人与歌手兼词曲作者罗布·贝尔德一起加入了福特赛车和Enchanté快闪活动，在周五晚上一起演奏他与美国大奖赛旅途中共创作的原创歌曲。
一位粉丝在Instagram上发布的表演视频，截至写作时已经获得了超过7000个赞。一位粉丝评论说：“这治愈了我心中的某一部分，”另一位粉丝补充说：“我敢打赌他上辈子要么是鲍勃·迪伦的兄弟，要么是个牛仔哈哈。我们爱你，丹尼尔。”
“在这个时候，没有人关心比赛。很高兴看到丹尼尔回来了，即使他不再赛车，”另一位粉丝写道，另一位粉丝写道：“作为一个音乐家和蜜獾粉丝，和丹尼·里卡多一起演奏是我的梦想。”
“我是说真的很长的一段路。沙漠、乡村小道、游泳洞，所有这些。说实话，我迫不及待了。”
这次长途旅行是推广新系列 Enchanté Collection 的活动之一，名为《长途》。这些新产品在奥斯汀的 Distribution Hall 的临时展位上出售，展位上还有食品、饮料、闪粉纹身和赛车模拟器。
里卡多也被看到在支持 小红牛 车队的车手利亚姆·劳森，作为新西兰人，他在 Esses Bazaar ATX 活动中担任主角，与利亚姆·劳森和朋友们一起在东第六街的 Inn Cahoots 举办车库音乐会，此次活动是为本周末的美国大奖赛做准备。
detailEn: Daniel Ricciardo surprises F1 fans with on-stage performance ahead of US GP
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo surprised fans with a harmonica performance alongside musician Rob Baird
Daniel Ricciardo , Drive to Survive Season 7
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo made a surprise appearance on stage in Austin, Texas, with American singer-songwriter Rob Baird.
The Australian joined Baird at the Ford Racing and Enchanté pop-up on Friday night to play harmonica on an original song he co-wrote with Baird during a road trip to the United States Grand Prix.

A fan video of the performance, posted on Instagram, had picked up more than 7000 likes by the time of writing. "This healed something in me," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm sure he was either Bob Dylan's brother or a cowboy in a previous life lol. We love you, Daniel."

"At this point, no one cares about the race. Glad to see Daniel back, even if he’s not racing," someone else posted, and another fan wrote: "As a musician and a honey badger fan, it would be a dream to play with Danny Ric."
"And I mean the lonnnng way. Desert, backroads, swimming holes, all of it. Not gonna lie, I can't wait."

The road trip was part of the promotion of the new Enchanté collection, The Long Road. The new products are being sold at a pop-up at Distribution Hall in Austin alongside food, drinks, flash tattoos and racing simulators.

Ricciardo was also spotted supporting Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson as the New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends as part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.
keyPointsZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多在美国大奖赛前夕与罗布·巴伊德共同登台表演。
两位在福特赛车和Enchanté快闪店现场演奏。
里卡多与巴伊德合作创作了一首歌曲，并在美国大奖赛之旅中共同演奏。
keyPointsEn: Daniel Ricciardo made a surprise appearance with Rob Baird.
The performance took place at the Ford Racing and Enchanté pop-up.
Ricciardo and Baird co-wrote and performed a song during their road trip to the United States Grand Prix.
